title: Brushy Brush Your Teeth 🎶 Nursery Rhyme with Lyrics | Sing Along
description:
Sing along with us! Lyrics on screen, fun verses and a karaoke part to sing on your own. 🎶

Lyrics :
Brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
up and down and round and round we go,
brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
shiny, clean and sparkly, hip hooray!

Brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
gentle little circles, nice and slow,
brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
shiny, clean and sparkly, hip hooray!

Brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
rinse and spit, and give a great big smile,
brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
shiny, clean and sparkly, hip hooray!

Brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
Ding and Dang have teeth that shine so bright!
brushy, brushy, brush, brush your teeth,
shiny, clean and sparkly, hip hooray!

Original song by Ding Dang Nursery Rhymes: original lyrics, music and animation. Synthetic voice: Piper ("lessac" voice).
